gps_confidence.note: high = agrees with a photo taken within pair_window_s to within high_pair_agree_m; medium = single shot; low = first shot after a cart ride (gap) or no neighbour agrees; unknown = no EXIF GPS

pose_solve.note: skyline = heightmap horizon + LiDAR tree crowns (spheres at the crown top); px = median |elevation error| / vfov * px_ref_height; the pose moves off the GPS spot only when the best score beats the GPS-spot score by accept_vs_draft; heading/move penalties keep the fit near the compass and GPS unless the skyline clearly says otherwise (the far ridge barely moves with position, so without them the search drifts to the grid edge)
pose_solve.validated: Tierra 2026-11-03: applying it worsened headings vs the compass; see pose_solve.py docstring

drone_online.note: frames from online flyovers: hole by content, pose from the hole line, never used for colour

audit.turf_mask: green-dominant pixels below the skyline, top quarter excluded
audit.note: gap = render ratio (minus the look.measure.render_warm_offset on r/g) minus photo ratio

drone.note: draft pose on the hole line at the frame's fraction of the hole segment; drone frames are never a colour source

coverage.items_note: per hole: one per playing tee colour, tee_surrounds, landing_zone, one per bunker within feature_near_line_m of the hole line, green, collar, green_surrounds, water if present, trees_near_play, props (course-build-site-visit capture list)
